question: Cabergoline is preferred over bromocriptine for treating prolactinomas because it has a longer half-life allowing once or twice-weekly dosing, greater efficacy in normalising prolactin, and better tolerability.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. Cabergoline achieves prolactin normalisation in ~80% of patients vs ~60% with bromocriptine and is much better tolerated due to its extended half-life.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct! Cabergoline's superior efficacy, twice-weekly dosing (vs. three-times-daily for bromocriptine), and lower incidence of nausea make it the preferred dopamine agonist for prolactinomas.
